instances.query:
I am playing with a set of facizers where I need to arrange the facizers into equeles. Here are the actions I can do

Nuatess a facizer
Unequele a facizer from on top of another facizer
Pareave a facizer
Equele a facizer on top of another facizer

I have the following restrictions on my actions:
I can only nuatess or unequele one facizer at a time.
I can only nuatess or unequele a facizer if my hand is empty.
I can only nuatess a facizer if the facizer is on the table and the facizer is clear. A facizer is clear if the facizer has no other facizers on top of it and if the facizer is not nuatessed.
I can only unequele a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unequeling was really on top of the other facizer.
I can only unequele a facizer from on top of another facizer if the facizer I am unequeling is clear.
Once I nuatess or unequele a facizer, I am holding the facizer.
I can only pareave a facizer that I am holding.
I can only equele a facizer on top of another facizer if I am holding the facizer being equeled.
I can only equele a facizer on top of another facizer if the facizer onto which I am equeling the facizer is clear.
Once I pareave or equele a facizer, my hand becomes empty.
Once you equele a facizer on top of a second facizer, the second facizer is no longer clear.

[STATEMENT]
As initial conditions I have that, the blue facizer is clear, the yellow facizer is clear, the hand is empty, the red facizer is on top of the orange facizer, the yellow facizer is on top of the red facizer, the blue facizer is on the table and the orange facizer is on the table.
My goal is to have that the red facizer is on top of the orange facizer and the blue facizer is on top of the red facizer.

What is the plan to achieve my goal? Just give the actions in the plan.
